title: Instinct of Survival
summary: Untrained and facing a 15-foot Greater Shadow Hound, Ha-Jun relies purely on sovereign survival instincts. Using the Sovereign Domain to slow the beast and awakening the Sovereign Blood Claws, he splits the monster's Void Cannon and obliterates it to protect the university.

panels.action: The Greater Shadow Hound bears its massive weight down onto Ha-Jun's gauntlet; cobblestones crumble beneath his boots.
panels.prose_en: The Greater Shadow Hound bears its massive weight down onto Ha-Jun's gauntlet; cobblestones crumble beneath his boots.
panels.prose_hi: Greater shadow hound ha-jun ki chunauti par apna bhari bhaar vahan karta hai; uske jooton ke neeche patthar ukhad rahe han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's sneakers dig deep trenches into the stone plaza, friction sparks flying as he grits his teeth in defiance.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's sneakers dig deep trenches into the stone plaza, friction sparks flying as he grits his teeth in defiance.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke sneakers patthar ke maidan mein gahri khaiyan khodte han, jab wah avagya mein apne dant pista hai to gharshan ki chingari udti hai.

panels.action: Kuro's telepathic shout echoes: 'Ladke! Tum koi pehelwan nahi ho! Domain ka istemal karo aur daayre ko dhabao!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Domain use karo! Uske wazan se lado mat!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's telepathic shout echoes: 'Ladke! Tum koi pehelwan nahi ho! Domain ka istemal karo aur daayre ko dhabao!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki telepathic cheekh goonjati hai: 'ladke! tum koi pahalwaan nahin ho! domain ka istimaal karo aur dire ko dhabao!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes flash with electric violet light: 'Domain... ACTIVATE!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes flash with electric violet light: 'Domain... ACTIVATE!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki aankhen electric violet roshni se chamakti han: 'domen... sakriya karen!'.

panels.action: A 5-meter transparent violet sphere expands instantly from Ha-Jun's core, swallowing the hound's front legs and maw.
panels.prose_en: A 5-meter transparent violet sphere expands instantly from Ha-Jun's core, swallowing the hound's front legs and maw.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke core se 5 meter ka pardarshi baingani gola turant failta hai, jo shikari kutte ke agle pairon aur jabde ko nigal jata hai.

panels.action: Inside the domain, the beast's movements slow to a crawl, trapped in dense sovereign gravity like insects in amber.

dialogue.speaker: shadow_hound
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh hawa itni bhaari kyun ho gayi...?!

panels.prose_en: Inside the domain, the beast's movements slow to a crawl, trapped in dense sovereign gravity like insects in amber.
panels.prose_hi: Domen ke ander, janwar ki chaal dhimi gati se rengti hai, amber mein keedon ki tarah ghane samprabhu gurutvakarshan mein fans jaati hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun smoothly slips to the left, slipping out from under the beast's downward trajectory with effortless grace.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smoothly slips to the left, slipping out from under the beast's downward trajectory with effortless grace.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aasani se bai or fisal jata hai, sahaj anugrah ke saath janwar ke neeche ki or prakshepavakra ke neeche se fisal jata hai.

panels.action: The beast's massive claw slams into empty cobblestones, blasting an empty crater into the pavement.
panels.prose_en: The beast's massive claw slams into empty cobblestones, blasting an empty crater into the pavement.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar ka vishal panja khali pattharon se takrata hai, jisse footpath par ek khali gaddha ban jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun sprints around to the monster's exposed rib flank, his gauntlet humming with jagged violet lightning arcs.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sprints around to the monster's exposed rib flank, his gauntlet humming with jagged violet lightning arcs.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun rakshas ki ujagar pasli ke parshva bhag ki or teji se daudta hai, uska hathiyar dantedar baingani bijli ke chapon ke saath gungunata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's gauntlet fingers flex: Three 2-foot long razor-sharp violet mana blades ignite from his knuckles like energy claws.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's gauntlet fingers flex: Three 2-foot long razor-sharp violet mana blades ignite from his knuckles like energy claws.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki gauntlet ungaliyan lachakti han: teen 2 foot lambe ustra-nukile baingani man blade urja panje ki tarah uske por se prajvalit hote han.

panels.action: A floating violet system prompt: [SKILL AWAKENED: SOVEREIGN BLOOD CLAWS (RANK F)].
panels.prose_en: A floating violet system prompt: [SKILL AWAKENED: SOVEREIGN BLOOD CLAWS (RANK F)].
panels.prose_hi: Ek floating violet system prompt: [kaushal jagrit: samprabhu rakt panje (rank f)].

panels.action: Ha-Jun slashes his blood claws diagonally upward into the beast's thick obsidian rib armor with all his strength.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slashes his blood claws diagonally upward into the beast's thick obsidian rib armor with all his strength.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni puri takat se apne khoon ke panjon ko janwar ke mote obsidian rib kavach mein tirche upar ki or kaatata hai.

panels.action: The violet claws slice through the hardened demonic armor like parchment, spraying black ichor and bone fragments into the rain.
panels.prose_en: The violet claws slice through the hardened demonic armor like parchment, spraying black ichor and bone fragments into the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni panje charmpatra ki tarah kathor rakshasi kavach ​​ko kaatate han, kale ichor aur haddi ke tukdon ko baarish mein chhidakte han.

panels.action: In berserk pain, the Shadow Hound whips its massive spiked tail horizontally like a battering ram.
panels.prose_en: In berserk pain, the Shadow Hound whips its massive spiked tail horizontally like a battering ram.
panels.prose_hi: Betahasha dard men, shadow hound apni vishal nukili poonch ko peetate hue medhe ki tarah kshaitij roop se maarta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun blocks with his gauntlet, but the tail's concussive force catches his side, sending him skidding 20 feet across the plaza.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun blocks with his gauntlet, but the tail's concussive force catches his side, sending him skidding 20 feet across the plaza.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne hathiyar se rokta hai, lekin poonch ki prerak shakti uske paksh ko pakad leti hai, jisse wah plaza ke paar 20 feet tak fisal jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun steadies his stance; white healing steam hisses from his ribs as fractured bone instantly knits back together.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Regeneration... turant kaam kar raha hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steadies his stance; white healing steam hisses from his ribs as fractured bone instantly knits back together.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apna rukh sthir rakha; uski pasliyon se safed upcharatmak bhaap nikalti hai aur tuti hui haddi turant wapas jud jaati hai.

panels.action: The beast unhinges its three-jawed maw: A spinning vortex of black and red gravitational void energy gathers in its throat.
panels.prose_en: The beast unhinges its three-jawed maw: A spinning vortex of black and red gravitational void energy gathers in its throat.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar apne teen-jabade wale panje ko khol deta hai: kale aur lal gurutvakarshan shunya urja ka ek ghumta hua bhanwar uske gale mein ikattha ho jata hai.

panels.action: Kuro: 'DHAYAN SE! VOID CANNON HAI! Agar wo campus par gira, toh saikdo masoom maare jayenge!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Roko use! Wo poori building ko uda dega!

panels.prose_en: Kuro: 'DHAYAN SE! VOID CANNON HAI! Agar wo campus par gira, toh saikdo masoom maare jayenge!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro: 'dhyan se! shunya top hai! agar wah campus mein gira, to saikdo masoom maare jaenge!'.

panels.action: Behind classroom windows, dozens of terrified students and teachers watch in breathless prayer.

dialogue.text: In sabki jaan ab uske haathon mein thi.

panels.prose_en: Behind classroom windows, dozens of terrified students and teachers watch in breathless prayer.
panels.prose_hi: Kaksha ki khidkiyon ke pichhe, darjanon bhaybhit chhatra aur shikshak bedam prarthana karte hue dekh rahe han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands his ground, eyes burning like twin purple stars: 'Maine vaada kiya tha... main dubara nahi bhaagunga!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands his ground, eyes burning like twin purple stars: 'Maine vaada kiya tha... main dubara nahi bhaagunga!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apni baat par kayam hai, uski aankhen judwan baingani sitaron ki tarah jal rahi han: 'maine vaada kiya tha... main dobara nahin bhagunga!'

panels.action: Ha-Jun draws his right arm back; crystalline spikes erupt along the gauntlet as swirling violet-magenta hellfire engulfs his entire frame.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws his right arm back; crystalline spikes erupt along the gauntlet as swirling violet-magenta hellfire engulfs his entire frame.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna dahina haath peeche khinchta hai; crystaliy spikes gauntlet ke saath futate hain kyonki ghumti hui bangni-magenta narkankaal ki aag uske poore frame ko gher leti hai.

panels.action: The beast unleashes the Void Cannon: A massive 10-foot beam of pitch-black destructive antimatter tears across the cobblestones.
panels.prose_en: The beast unleashes the Void Cannon: A massive 10-foot beam of pitch-black destructive antimatter tears across the cobblestones.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar shunya top ko kholta hai: pich-kale vinashkari antimatter ki ek vishal 10 foot ki kiran kobalston mein toot jaati hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun sprints directly into the path of the beam, fist cocked back, completely devoid of fear.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sprints directly into the path of the beam, fist cocked back, completely devoid of fear.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sidhe beam ke raste mein daudta hai, peeche ki or mutthi bandhe, puri tarah se dar se rahit.

panels.shot: splitting the void beam in two
panels.action: Ha-Jun's crystalline gauntlet punches straight into the void beam, parting the black energy cleanly in two like Moses parting the sea.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's crystalline gauntlet punches straight into the void beam, parting the black energy cleanly in two like Moses parting the sea.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ka crystaliy hathiyar sidhe shunya kiran mein ghunsa maarta hai, jisse kali urja spasht roop se do bhagon mein vibhajit ho jaati hai jaise musa ne samudra ko vibhajit kiya tha.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's fist drives clean through the beast's armored forehead, detonating in a blinding flash of pure violet mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's fist drives clean through the beast's armored forehead, detonating in a blinding flash of pure violet mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki mutthi janwar ke bakhtarband mathe ke madhyam se saaf ho jaati hai, jo shuddh baingani maina ki ek chakachaundh flash mein visfot karti hai.

panels.action: A majestic dome of violet light engulfs the courtyard, blowing away storm clouds and revealing glimpses of blue sky.
panels.prose_en: A majestic dome of violet light engulfs the courtyard, blowing away storm clouds and revealing glimpses of blue sky.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni roshni ka ek rajsi gumbad aangan ko gher leta hai, toofani baadalon ko uda deta hai aur neele aakash ki jhalak dikhata hai.

panels.action: The 15-foot beast crumbles into glittering purple ash, drifting harmlessly onto the wet grass.
panels.prose_en: The 15-foot beast crumbles into glittering purple ash, drifting harmlessly onto the wet grass.
panels.prose_hi: 15 foot ka janwar chamakdar baingani raakh mein badal jata hai aur gili ghas par hanirahit roop se bahta hai.

panels.action: A glowing fist-sized violet core hovers and fuses into Ha-Jun's hand: [SYNCHRONIZATION ADVANCED: 8.5%].
panels.prose_en: A glowing fist-sized violet core hovers and fuses into Ha-Jun's hand: [SYNCHRONIZATION ADVANCED: 8.5%].
panels.prose_hi: Ek chamakdar mutthi ke aakaar ka baingani core mandrata hai aur ha-jun ke haath mein fuse ho jata hai: [sinkranization unnat: 8.5%].

panels.action: Min-Jae sits among the rubble, adjusting his glasses in total stupefaction: 'Ha-Jun... tum... tum aakhir kya ho...?'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... tumne abhi... ek monster ko maar diya...?

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae sits among the rubble, adjusting his glasses in total stupefaction: 'Ha-Jun... tum... tum aakhir kya ho...?'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je malbe ke beech baithta hai, puri tarah se stabdh hokar apna chashma theek karta hai: 'ha-jun... tum... tum aakhir kya ho...?'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands in the smoking crater, his gauntlet dissolving into his arm as his eyes return to dark brown: 'Min-Jae... kisi ko mat batana.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Min-Jae... yeh baat hum dono ke beech rahegi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands in the smoking crater, his gauntlet dissolving into his arm as his eyes return to dark brown: 'Min-Jae... kisi ko mat batana.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dhumrapan ke gaddhe mein khada hai, uska kavach uski baanh mein ghul raha hai aur uski aankhen gahre bhure rang mein laut rahi han: 'min-je... kisi ko mat batana.'
